title: Zesty Dutch Porcini Pilaf
description: A buttery and tender Dutch dish featuring porcini mushrooms, perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the porcini mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the basmati rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt, black pepper, and bhuna curry powder.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
